# Pure

> Server-rendered real-estate demo. Search is a path under `/demo/`, not a query string. Read this file before building a search URL.

Pages that cover this site link it with `rel="describedby"` (`/llms.txt`). On GitHub Pages the site lives under `/pure/`, so the same file is `/pure/llms.txt` and every search path below is prefixed with `/pure`. The `/pure` segment is the deploy folder, not part of the search.

## How to search

Build a path with `getPathByGeo` in `helpers/geo.js`. Lowercase the state code. Turn spaces into hyphens. Strip a trailing word `city` or `county` from those names.

- State: `/demo/{state}` — `/demo/tx`
- County: `/demo/{state}/{county}_county` — `/demo/tx/harris_county`
- City: `/demo/{state}/{city}` — `/demo/tx/houston`
- Zip: `/demo/{state}/{zip}` — `/demo/tx/77002`
- Neighborhood: `/demo/{state}/{city}/{neighborhood}_neighborhood`
- Address: `/demo/{state}/{city}/{address}_address`

`/demo` and `/demo/` redirect to `/demo/sitemap`. Sitemap drills down: `/demo/sitemap`, `/demo/sitemap/{state}`, `/demo/sitemap/{state}/{county}_county`, `/demo/sitemap/{state}/{city}`.

A property detail URL is `/demo/detail/{state}/{zip}/{propertyId}`. A map URL is `/demo/{state}/{slug}/@{lat},{lng}`.

Those pages call nearby search with only `input` and `searchType`. `searchType` is the geo type in uppercase (`STATE`, `COUNTY`, `CITY`, `ZIPCODE`, `NEIGHBORHOOD`, `ADDRESS`). `input` is the first match of: `{zip} {state}`, `{neighborhood} {city} {state}`, `{city} {state}`, `{county} {state}`, `{state}`. An address has no input line of its own.

Price, beds, baths, and the other filters are not URL parameters. They are a JSON body on `POST /soa/property/searchHouse`. The demo HTML pages do not send that body.
